name: Training Cavern — Faceted Earthen Basin
subtitle: OSRS tutorial-mine reference vs live Crafted Realms gameplay camera
review_note: The live cave now uses one continuous shallow faceted bowl with raised irregular shoulders, warm cut-earth value changes, readable rock clusters, and clear cardinal lanes. The previous flat grid and oversized floor islands are gone.
verdict: accepted for the Tutor's Holm training slice
improve: Future atmosphere work can add localized dust and slightly brighter far-chamber fill without changing the accepted terrain topology.
